hero.lead: The software industry has it backwards. Cutting corners on your product isn't saving money—it's borrowing against the rework that you'll pay for later, with interest.
hero.reframe: "The only way to go fast is to go well." — Robert Martin
hero.subtext:
For business leaders building a new product — and for those wanting to integrate AI technology — BSF5Y is the engineering partner that builds it to last.


When investors audit your tech, it holds up. When your AI pilot meets real customers, it doesn't collapse. When you pivot, you don't start over.

positioning:
The difference between a product and a prototype isn't polish or features — it's where the value lives. Prototypes trap business logic in the UI. Products capture it in portable software any interface can use.

The same difference shows up in AI. Bolt-ons trap value in prompts and demos. Integrations capture it in systems that outlast any single vendor, model, or demo.

problem.label: The Founder's Reality
problem.headline: We understand what keeps you up at night.
statements: Development used to move so fast, but now adding a simple feature takes weeks.
The big reveal went great, delivery invoices were paid, and your tech partner went dark.
The investor's tech audits revealed a bunch of spit, duct tape, and mud.
You have to throw it all away and start over. Your investment has crashed.

aiQuestion.label: The AI Question
aiQuestion.headline: AI pilots fail for the same reason prototypes do.
aiQuestion.intro: Models change monthly. Vendors ship demos. What doesn't change is the work between a demo that impresses and a system that survives production. That work is engineering.

boltOn.label: Bolt-on AI
items: Every new vendor is a new rebuild
Nobody on the team knows why it works

aiQuestion.closer: Whether you're building with AI or adopting it, the discipline is the same.

methodology.headline: How We Work
methodology.intro: We follow a proven methodology that is designed to move past ideas and prototypes to deliver robust, market-ready products.

phases.name: Discovery
phases.question: Show us the vision.
phases.description: A successful partnership begins with shared understanding. We immerse ourselves in your vision to understand its core potential — what does version 1.0 look like, what gives it market credibility, and why does it need to exist.

phases.name: Differentiation
phases.question: What can only this product do?
phases.description: We identify what makes your product truly unique — the defensible core that sets it apart. Is it proprietary data, a novel algorithm, or deep domain expertise encoded in software? This is your core — whether you're building a product or integrating AI into one you already run. Everything else is infrastructure.

phases.name: Infrastructure
phases.question: Turn-key the rest.
phases.description: Everything that isn't your core differentiator is infrastructure. Web UIs, mobile apps, signup, authentication, payments, model hosting, vector search, etc. Infrastructure should be inexpensive — we provide off-the-shelf battle-tested solutions to deliver and support your product without further development costs.

phases.name: Execution
phases.question: Products, not prototypes.
phases.description: We deliver production-ready engineering solutions with exhaustive test coverage, clean architecture, and comprehensive documentation. Where AI is involved, that includes the evaluations and guardrails that separate a demo from a production system. A complete solution that can be handed to any future team with confidence.

phases.name: Enduring Partnership
phases.question: We're invested in your success.
phases.description: If we've chosen to partner with you, then we are 100% invested in your long-term success. Long after your product has shipped and the last invoice has been paid, we're going to be there for you, no matter what.

services.title: Technical Leadership
services.description: Senior engineering leadership for projects that need expert technical judgment without the equity, salary, or headcount.

services.title: Bespoke Solutions
services.description: We don't just advise — we build. Turn-key infrastructure plus custom development of your core IP. You get a product, not a prototype.

services.title: Production AI Systems
services.description: We integrate AI into your product — or the business you already run — with the engineering discipline that separates a demo from a production system. Evaluations, guardrails, and vendor-portable architecture, so your AI survives the next model, the next vendor, and the next compliance review.

services.title: Strategic Technology
services.description: Connect your existing systems — data, workflows, and modern AI capabilities — to reveal advantages already sitting in your business.

services.title: Recruitment & Staffing
services.description: When you're ready to hire, we help you find, evaluate, and onboard engineers who fit your culture and codebase. No recruiting agency markup. Just part of our last-mile delivery service to you.

services.title: Up-Skill Existing Teams
services.description: Paired programming, test-driven development, CI/CD, Agile practices, AI-Driven Development. We transfer our best practices so your team can sustain velocity without us.
